test_title: PYST 54: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Some items are purchased for Rs 4,500. If one-third of the articles are sold at a loss of 15%, then at what percentage profit should the remaining articles be sold, so that a profit of 20% is earned on the entire transaction?
solution: Formula used: Profit = Selling price - Cost price Profit % = {(Profit/Cost price) × 100} **Calculation** CP of total goods = Rs. 4500. CP of one third goods = 1/3 × 4500 = Rs. 1500
